changelog_text:
# NodeLock 0.1.0

Lock a destination attachment node with **Tab**, rotate with **WASD/QE** (**Shift** for fine rotation), then click to attach. Tap **Tab** again to unlock.

Includes bay connector adjustments for radial batteries, stock spherical RCS tanks and Tessera spheres. PurrlineTessera is optional. Load NodeLock after Core and PurrlineTessera if installed; disable separate BatteryBayCompat/TankBayCompat copies.

Requires **KSA 2026.11.16.5901** and **StarMap 0.5.4+**. Windows supported; Linux/macOS unverified. Inheritance is experimental. Carried subassemblies and general surface/edge attachment are unsupported.

[Usage and installation](https://github.com/DymndLab/NodeLock#readme) · [Issues](https://github.com/DymndLab/NodeLock/issues)

MIT license.
